text:
Maya D: Hey folks 1 quick review request. I've been iterating on a 'Suppression Presets' + 'Timeline Preview' in Alerting > SLOs. Goal: let users apply common suppression windows (maintenance, nightly quiet, holidays) quickly and visually confirm what alerts will be silenced. Figma: https://figma.redwood/suppression-presets (WIP)
Oliver K: Love presets. UX Q: how do we show conflicts between an active schedule and a manual one-off suppression?
Maya D: Proposal: timeline shows stacked bars; conflicting segments get a diagonal hatch and a tooltip explaining precedence (manual > preset).
Samir: Tooltip copy suggestion: 'Manual suppression (takes precedence)'. Keep it short.
Chris (PM): Also need an off-ramp: a single-click 'revoke temporary suppression' in the incident view. If a preset silences something unexpectedly, ops should be able to unmute quickly.
Zara - Eng: Backend note: presets will be stored as RFC 5545 RRULE-like objects for recurrence. Quick example payload:
```
POST /api/v1/suppressions/presets
{
  "name": "Nightly Quiet",
  "tz": "America/Los_Angeles",
  "rrule": "FREQ=DAILY;BYHOUR=23;BYMINUTE=0;BYSECOND=0;COUNT=1",
  "duration_minutes": 480
}
```
Maya D: Thanks — showing that JSON in the handoff will help. UI question: should presets be global (org-wide) or scoped to a project/team?
Oliver K: Scoped to the SLO or project by default, with an option to 'publish org preset' if you have permissions. Avoid global noise.
Samir: Copy tweak for publish flow: 'Publish preset for org use (admins only)'.
Chris (PM): Accessibility: timeline must be reachable via keyboard and have text equivalents. For screen readers, present the next three suppression windows as a list with start/end and label.
DesignBot: Accessibility check: ensure each timeline segment has role="button" and aria-label="Suppression: Nightly Quiet, starts Oct 13 23:00, duration 8h". Add an aria-live region to announce when a preset is toggled.
Maya D: Visual contrast nit: current preset color on the timeline is 12% contrast vs background. I'll adjust to pass AA for small text. Also considering an optional pattern overlay for color-blind users.
Zara - Eng: Perf & data note: computing expanded occurrences for RRULEs can be heavy for long horizons. We should cap preview to 30 days unless user requests full calendar. Cache expanded occurrences per preset.
Oliver K: Mobile behavior: timeline should collapse to a compact list with mini-pill chips showing day+time. Swipe-to-expand for details? Not sure.
Maya D: My mobile mock collapses to a stacked list with a chevron to expand each preset. Swipe actions for quick enable/disable would be nice but maybe separate.
Samir: Copy for the toggle: 'Enabled (snoozing notifications)' vs just 'Snoozed' . Short is better in tight spaces.
Chris (PM): Edge case: channel-level formatting differences — some channels strip markdown. The preview should show channel-specific rendering when possible or note "formatting may vary by channel".
Maya D: I'll add per-channel preview rows (collapsed by default) and a small helper: 'Preview respects channel formatting rules.'
DesignBot: Added checklist: [ ] fix contrast, [ ] add SR list of next 3 windows, [ ] cap expand to 30d, [ ] publish/permission copy, [ ] per-channel preview row.
Maya D: Thanks team. If anyone has tighter copy options for tooltips or the small mobile pill text, drop them here and I'll A/B in the mock.
